title: The Morning Digest  -  September 23, 2026
dek: "Reconstructed edition  -  the morning run failed; rebuilt from the day's wires and the following edition. WTI and Brent closed Tuesday at two-week lows after six straight down days; the Saudi East-West restart was confirmed; EIA weekly due Wednesday morning."

claims.text: The call: Saudi East-West restart CONFIRMED
The call: EIA weekly lands this morning
Geopolitics through a supply/demand lens: Hormuz escalation.
Geopolitics through a supply/demand lens: UNGA diplomacy.
Geopolitics through a supply/demand lens: Sanctions overhang.
Ukraine / Russia: Moscow refinery (~245 kb/d) damaged Sep 20

Ukraine / Russia: Russian refining attrition is becoming a products story: gasoline output down roughly 20% vs 2025, diesel down roughly 30% (IEA figures, unverified)  -  constructive for distillate cracks.
Canada: refineries: BP Whiting returned to normal operations Monday
Canada: refineries: Joliet: still no confirmed restart.
Cracks & positioning: ICE gasoil crack near $95/bbl
Cracks & positioning: Brent managed-money net length: 282,657 contracts
Venezuela: Merey discounts widening on record freight

Egress: The pipes remain functionally full: Keystone ~94%, Trans Mountain ~96%, Enbridge Mainline ~94% of available capacity (June data, latest available). Spare takeaway near 272 kb/d and tightening  -  the standing WCS-widening risk.
